answer: An operator copying one text across 107 aliases as a result pays for 107 attestations that collapse into a single endorsement, because the hash is the same for all of them. Since the kernel hash is stored at intake, the forge graph groups the endorsements and the timber audit exposes the collapse. An attestation must carry the content hash of the answer it endorses, and 5 attestations that point at the same hash across different identities are flagged as copied. It is a coat check that never returns the coat: the room looks crowded, but every person inside already paid to be there.
